title: Month 1, Week 3 (Nov 22 – Nov 28, 2026): Sellar/Nerve Sheath, Non-Neoplastic CNS, Muscle/Nerve Biopsy & EM

days.b1:
Retrieval (15m): Write out Meningioma Grade 2 (including 3 of 5 minor criteria) and Grade 3 criteria.
Reading (75m): WHO CNS5 — Nerve Sheath (Schwannoma, Neurofibroma, Perineurioma EMA/CLDN1/GLUT1+, MPNST H3K27me3 loss), Sellar Region (Adamantinomatous [CTNNB1/nuclear β-catenin] vs. Papillary [BRAF V600E] Craniopharyngioma, PitNET transcription factors PIT1, TPIT, SF1, Pituicytoma/Spindle cell oncocytoma/Granular cell tumor TTF1+), & Hemangioblastoma (VHL).
days.b2:
Spot Slides (15m): 5 CNS slides @ 3m/case (Schwannoma Antoni A/B & Verocay bodies, Craniopharyngioma subtypes, PitNET, Hemangioblastoma).
QBank (30m): 15 CNS Sellar/Nerve Sheath MCQs.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Log 4-Domain SOE entry on Cerebellar Hemangioblastoma (Inhibin-A+, S100+, D2-40+, PAX8-, EMA-, CD10-) vs. Metastatic Clear Cell RCC (PAX8+, EMA+, CD10+, CAIX+).

days.b1:
Retrieval (15m): Recall PitNET transcription factors (PIT1: GH/PRL/TSH; TPIT: ACTH; SF1: Gonadotroph) and TTF1+ posterior pituitary tumors.
Reading (75m): Rosai & WHO CNS5 — Primary CNS DLBCL (MYD88 L265P), CNS Germ Cell Tumors, Chordoma (Brachyury+) vs. Chondrosarcoma, & Non-Neoplastic CNS (HSV, CMV, PML/JC virus, Toxoplasmosis, Cryptococcus, CJD/Prion, Multiple Sclerosis/LFB, Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, ALS).
days.b2:
Spot Slides (15m): 5 slides @ 3m/case (Chordoma physaliferous cells, PML bizarre astrocytes/oligodendroglial inclusions, MS demyelinating plaque with macrophages, Cryptococcus, Toxoplasma).
QBank (20m): 15 Non-Neoplastic CNS MCQs.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Log Non-Neoplastic CNS Inclusion Bodies & Special Stains (Negri, Cowdry A, PML, Marinesco, Bunina, Hirano, Lewy, Pick, Luxol Fast Blue + PAS).

days.b1: Retrieval (15m): Flash-recall Chordoma (Brachyury+, CK+, EMA+, S100+) vs. Chondrosarcoma (Brachyury-, CK/EMA-) vs. Chordoid Meningioma (EMA+, SSTR2A+, Brachyury-).
days.b2:
Slide Sprint (60m): 10 Timed Slides: 6 CNS Neoplastic/Infectious slides (3m/case) + 4 Thyroid FNA slides (Medullary Thyroid Carcinoma amyloid/calcitonin, Anaplastic, Parathyroid @ 6m/case).
QBank (45m): 20 Timed MCQs.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Run the 20m SOE Timer on an intraoperative ring-enhancing brain biopsy (Primary CNS DLBCL vs. GBM vs. Abscess/Toxoplasma — why you halt resection in lymphoma!).

days.b1: Secondary System — Nerve & Muscle Biopsy + EM (90m): SCFHS Curriculum Neuropathology & EM Objectives — Fresh snap-frozen muscle triage (isopentane cooled in liquid nitrogen), ATPase pH 9.4 vs. pH 4.3/4.6 fiber typing, NADH-TR, SDH, COX, Modified Gomori Trichrome, PAS, Oil Red O; Neurogenic atrophy vs. Myopathy; Dermatomyositis vs. Polymyositis vs. IBM; & Diagnostic EM.
days.b2: QBank & Images (30m): 15 Muscle/Nerve & EM MCQs + 6 muscle histochemistry/EM images (perifascicular atrophy, ragged red fibers, rimmed vacuoles, nemaline rods, central cores).
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Master One-Pager 3 (Skeletal Muscle Biopsy Enzyme Histochemistry, Inflammatory Myopathies & Diagnostic EM).

days.b1: Retrieval (15m): Write out the Muscle Biopsy histochemical stain panel and Dermatomyositis vs. Polymyositis vs. IBM discriminators from memory.
days.b2:
QBank Sprint (60m): 30 Timed MCQs (15 CNS/Muscle/EM + 15 2015–2023 Trainee Recalls on Neuropathology & EM).
Deep Review (45m): Audit all missed recall explanations.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Log all CNS frozen section and muscle biopsy recall traps.

days.b2: (Optional) 30m review of Week 3 SOE Log entries.
days.b3: Click Push to sync Week 3 progress to GitHub.

days.b1: Neuropathology Consolidation & Lester Frozen Section Review (2.5h): Complete review of One-Pagers 1–3 + Susan Lester Neuropathology Intraoperative Consultation (crush prep vs. cryostat artifacts, meningioma whorls, oligodendroglioma halo loss on frozen, lymphoma discohesion).
days.b2: CNS Mastery Mini-Mock (90m): 20 Timed CNS Virtual Spot Slides (60m @ 3m/case) + 30 Timed CNS & Molecular/EM MCQs (30m).
days.b3: SOE Deliverable (30m): Update your CNS Confidence Slider in Tab 4 (Target: 1/5 -> 3/5) and log any remaining weak entities.
